title.narrative: OEE 2 UNWomen effectively leverages and expands its partnerships communications and advocacy capabilities to increase support for and financing of the gender equality agenda while securing sustainable resourcing for the delivery of its own mandate

description.narrative:
UN Women is balancing the dual partnership function of mobilizing and managing partnerships and resources to 1 finance the full implementation of its Strategic Plan growing resources and 2 convene partnerships and influence resource flows in support of the wider gender equality and womens empowerment mandate leveraging and influencing
